diagnosis: The former 0x07 setting was AP3216C one-shot ALS+PS mode, not continuous ALS+PS+IR. Repeated reads therefore returned one conversion. Mode 0x03 is the documented continuous ALS+PS mode; PS includes IR. With 0x03, independently read 0x0A-0x0F registers vary autonomously.
identity_basis: Pandora V2.4 schematic explicitly labels U8 as AP3216C; the maintained RT-Thread AP3216C package uses the same 0x1E address, mode encoding, and register map.
limitations: No controlled uncovered/far versus covered/near stimulus was performed after the fix.
This capture proves fresh autonomous register updates, not a qualified optical/proximity delta.
Interrupt status remained 0x00; interrupt threshold/INT-pin behavior was not tested.
The earlier /tmp/ap3216c-user-dynamic.raw capture remains diagnostic only and must not be promoted to dynamic B1.
